result.summary: The page is mostly well-rendered, but there are a few visual/functional inconsistencies: the selected 'Pizza' filter doesn't match the displayed content, a category chip is clipped and appears empty at the screen edge, and text in the horizontally scrolling card list is truncated.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' filter chip is shown as selected (dark/active state), but the visible content includes poké bowls, burgers, trattoria pasta, and a ramen bar — none of which are pizza-filtered results.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the content list actually filters by the selected category, or reset the chip to 'All' if no filter is applied.

issues.description: A category chip on the far right of the filter row (after 'Healthy') is cut off and appears as an empty gray pill with no visible label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll padding or peek amount so partially visible chips still show at least part of their label, indicating scrollable content.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated by the screen edge without an ellipsis or clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis within the card bounds, or ensure the card peek clearly communicates horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The white delivery-time badges (e.g., '20–30 min') sit on light card imagery in places (Green Bowl Poké card), giving low contrast between badge and background.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle border or shadow to the badges to ensure they remain distinguishable on light backgrounds.
